scope: mask-only independent review; no generated H&E was available or used

decisions.reason: Hard gates pass, but candidate 03 has the higher local-population score and more source-like nearest-neighbor spacing with comparable tissue geometry.
Hard gates pass, but candidate 03 has a higher local-population score and a smaller clustering shift while preserving the same authorized expansion.
All candidates pass the frozen gates. Candidate 03 has the strongest local-population score and balanced nearest-neighbor and clustering behavior while retaining coherent significant tumor expansion.
decisions.tissue_geometry: The 84,677-pixel joint change follows authorized tumor-stroma boundaries; its 76,398-pixel tissue component remains anchored to native tumor and preserves adjacent non-target compartments.
decisions.nucleus_layout: The 29 placed nuclei are complete, non-overlapping and contained. Source-relative area-p95, count, NND and Ripley ratios are 1.204, 0.795, 1.058 and 1.208, with sampling score 0.910.
decisions.coupling: Added nuclei occupy the authorized tumor expansion; quota, seam, compatibility, spatial-distribution and local-density checks pass.
decisions.preserved_conditions: Protected nuclei, prohibited regions and support-exterior instances remain unchanged without partial-instance, overlap, border or containment violations.
decisions.limitations: Nuclei are larger and fewer than the source reference and clustering is elevated, although all values remain within the frozen envelope. Mask-only evidence does not establish H&E quality or clinical validity.
decisions.verdict: Approve candidate 03 as the single mask-condition handoff.
